releaseNotes.summary: This release makes wallet funding and account navigation clearer in the storage app.

sections.title: Wallet
items: You can now deposit supported Internet Computer tokens to your Principal ID.
The wallet now shows which Internet Computer funds are on your Principal ID and which funds are already available in your Rabbithole balance.
You can now withdraw supported wallet balances to Internet Computer, Base, and Solana wallets.

sections.title: Navigation
items: Account settings, subscription, and wallet screens now support direct links.
Refreshing or opening storage app links directly works more reliably.
